about: Test description of the Quinn case. The answer key is answer_key.json (made from answer_sheet.doc); the lines, steps, and notes are in source/cases/quinn.js. This file tells the tests which PDF goes with each step.
todoWhy: Steps E and F leave the MWP Worksheet entries (N3) and the TS Note box (NN) for the student to finish.
pdfWhy: The case author's printouts printed James's months in the home as 12 on TaxSlayer's dependent summary (page 2); the problem says 7, and the case author confirmed 7 on November 20, 2026. These printouts are hers with only that number changed to 7 (the FTB 3532 already shows 214 days). The originals are in original/: the saved-progress test uses the Step B original, and N1 must fail on every original.
